# get_config { #phasic.get_config }

```python
phasic.get_config()
```

Get current global configuration.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[PTDAlgorithmsConfig](`phasic.config.PTDAlgorithmsConfig`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Current configuration (creates default if none exists)

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> import phasic as ptd
>>> config = ptd.get_config()
>>> print(config.jax, config.jit, config.backend)
True True jax
```
